title: The Option That Was Mistyped: A Command Line That Says What Is Wrong, and Does Not Exit From Inside a Test
fallback: This lesson is about the arguments a program is started with, so it needs Qt. Lesson 00-10 is about a program that asks for a number and refuses what it cannot read, and lesson 01-13 about an argument that was not there, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: the command line of a control station, parsed into typed values, with an error that names what is wrong and a usage text, and without ending the program
